text.tspan: Figure 9. Baseline/intervention paired run: one-way aggregate sync over SyncChannel
Baseline Simulation (own thread, own Person population)
Intervention Simulation (own thread, own Person population)
aggregate tables only, no Person objects,
apply policy effects to risk factors
(with optional PIF if in policy window)
Initial cohort: same person IDs in both scenarios (id = slot + 1),
so optional per-person ID tracking compares the same starting
individuals even though life paths can diverge after intervention.
